steps.reply: {"action": "final_sql", "sql": "WITH prem AS (SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium FROM policy_amount pa JOIN premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier), claim_policy AS (SELECT DISTINCT cc.Claim_Identifier, pcd.Policy_Identifier FROM claim_coverage cc JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier), loss AS (SELECT cp.Policy_Identifier, SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_incurred_loss FROM claim_policy cp JOIN claim_amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cp.Claim_Identifier WHERE ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment UNION ALL SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve) GROUP BY cp.Policy_Identifier), holder AS (SELECT apr.Agreement_Identifier AS Policy_Identifier, MIN(pe.First_Name || ' ' || pe.Last_Name) AS policyholder_name FROM agreement_party_role apr JOIN person pe ON pe.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH' GROUP BY apr.Agreement_Identifier) SELECT po.Policy_Number, h.policyholder_name, COALESCE(pm.total_premium, 0) AS total_premium, COALESCE(l.total_incurred_loss, 0) AS total_incurred_loss FROM policy po LEFT JOIN holder h ON h.Policy_Identifier = po.Policy_Identifier LEFT JOIN prem pm ON pm.Policy_Identifier = po.Policy_Identifier LEFT JOIN loss l ON l.Policy_Identifier = po.Policy_Identifier ORDER BY po.Policy_Number"}
